words.enDefinition: owned before, as commonly stated on resale labels

examples.en: The camera shop keeps its pre-owned lenses in a separate display case.
examples.zh: 照相器材店把「二手」镜头放在单独的展示柜里。

examples.en: I chose a pre-owned clarinet that my music tutor had tried already.
examples.zh: 我选了一支音乐老师已经试过的「二手」单簧管。

words.enDefinition: restored to a good working condition after previous use

examples.en: My lab partner bought a refurbished laptop with a newly fitted keyboard.
examples.zh: 我的实验搭档买了一台「翻新」笔记本电脑，键盘是新换的。

examples.en: The shop displays refurbished tablets beside the counter for students to try.
examples.zh: 店家把「翻新」平板摆在柜台旁，方便学生试用。

words.enDefinition: restored to working order by or for the seller

examples.en: The old radio was listed as seller refurbished after the shop repaired it.
examples.zh: 店家修好旧收音机后，在商品页上标注了「卖家翻新」。

examples.en: The camera is marked seller refurbished because the shop replaced a damaged switch.
examples.zh: 那家店换过相机的坏开关，所以标了「卖家翻新」。

words.enDefinition: describing an item that does not work properly

examples.en: The printer was listed as for parts or not working because it could not feed paper.
examples.zh: 那台打印机无法进纸，所以商品页标注了「供拆件或无法使用」。

examples.en: I noticed the label for parts or not working underneath the photograph of the old camera.
examples.zh: 我在旧相机的照片下方看见了「供拆件或无法使用」的标注。

collocations: listed as for parts or not working
marked for parts or not working
for parts or not working category

words.enDefinition: a place online where people buy and sell used items

examples.en: Our flatmate found a used kitchen table on a local secondhand marketplace.
examples.zh: 室友在本地「二手交易平台」上找到了一张旧餐桌。

examples.en: I check the secondhand marketplace whenever someone in our flat needs a lamp.
examples.zh: 我们公寓里有人需要台灯时，我就会去「二手交易平台」看看。

words.enDefinition: a shop selling donated goods to raise money for charity

examples.en: I picked up several novels for my reading group at a charity shop.
examples.zh: 我在「慈善旧货店」给读书小组买了几本小说。

examples.en: The charity shop near our hall accepts clean coats and shoes on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 宿舍附近的「慈善旧货店」周六收干净的外套和鞋子。

words.enDefinition: a shop that sells goods on behalf of their owners

examples.en: A consignment shop downtown was selling the guitar on behalf of its owner.
examples.zh: 市区的一家「寄卖店」正在帮琴主出售那把吉他。

examples.en: I left my nearly new coat with a consignment shop before moving overseas.
examples.zh: 出国前，我把几乎全新的外套放在一家「寄卖店」代售。

words.enDefinition: a market where stalls often sell used or vintage goods

examples.en: We found matching bowls at a flea market held near the station.
examples.zh: 我们在车站附近举办的「跳蚤市场」上找到了同款的碗。

examples.en: The Saturday flea market had a stall selling old maps and postcards.
examples.zh: 周六的「跳蚤市场」有一个摊位卖旧地图和明信片。

words.enDefinition: an event where people meet to trade or sell goods

examples.en: I traded two of my old games at the student swap meet.
examples.zh: 我在学生「物品交换集市」上把两款旧游戏换了出去。

examples.en: Our neighbourhood swap meet had several tables of books people could trade.
examples.zh: 我们社区的「物品交换集市」摆了好几桌供人交换的书。

collocations: bring items to a swap meet

words.enDefinition: an event where people exchange clothing they no longer wear

examples.en: The art students ran a clothes swap in the hall on Friday.
examples.zh: 艺术专业学生周五在礼堂办了一场「衣物交换活动」。

examples.en: I took two jackets to the clothes swap and came home with a scarf.
examples.zh: 我拿了两件夹克去参加「衣物交换活动」，带回来一条围巾。

collocations: bring something to a clothes swap

words.enDefinition: an arrangement for exchanging books with other people

examples.en: We held a book exchange so first years could find affordable course readers.
examples.zh: 我们办了次「图书交换活动」，让大一学生能找到负担得起的课程读本。

examples.en: Mina brought her old novels to the book exchange after her final exam.
examples.zh: 米娜期末考试结束后，把旧小说带去参加「图书交换活动」。

words.enDefinition: a sale of used household goods held at someone's home

examples.en: I found an old bread tin at a neighbour's garage sale last Sunday.
examples.zh: 上周日，我在邻居办的「车库旧物售卖」上找到一个旧面包烤模。

examples.en: They put a garage sale sign on the lawn beside the student house.
examples.zh: 他们在学生合租屋旁的草坪上立了块「车库旧物售卖」的牌子。

words.enDefinition: a British sale where people display goods beside their cars

examples.en: Our friends in Leeds invited us to a car boot sale on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 我们在利兹的朋友邀我们周日早上去「汽车后备箱旧货市集」。

examples.en: At the car boot sale, I bought a stack of records from a teacher.
examples.zh: 我在「汽车后备箱旧货市集」上从一位老师手中买了一摞唱片。

collocations: go to a car boot sale

words.enDefinition: a sale of a household's possessions, often after someone's death

examples.en: A neighbour bought the armchair at an estate sale on our street.
examples.zh: 邻居在我们街上的一次「家中物品清售」中买下了这把扶手椅。

examples.en: The estate sale included most of the books and furniture from the house.
examples.zh: 这次「家中物品清售」出售了屋里大部分的书和家具。

words.enDefinition: a university sale of equipment or furniture it no longer needs

examples.en: Our library put some old reading chairs in the campus surplus sale this year.
examples.zh: 今年图书馆把几张旧阅览椅拿到「校园闲置资产出售」活动上卖。

examples.en: I bought a metal filing cabinet at the campus surplus sale by the gym.
examples.zh: 我在体育馆旁的「校园闲置资产出售」活动上买了一个金属文件柜。

collocations: find a desk at a campus surplus sale

words.enDefinition: clothes from an earlier era valued for their age or style

examples.en: My cousin sells vintage clothing at a small stall in the covered market.
examples.zh: 表亲在有顶市场的一个小摊位卖「复古旧衣」。

examples.en: The drama society borrowed some vintage clothing for a play set in the seventies.
examples.zh: 话剧社借来了一些「复古旧衣」，用于一部以七十年代为背景的戏。

words.enDefinition: a short advertisement placed under a category in a publication

examples.en: I spotted a classified ad for a folding bike in the student paper.
examples.zh: 我在学生报上看到一则卖折叠自行车的「分类广告」。

examples.en: Her classified ad for old shelving drew a reply from a nearby student.
examples.zh: 她发布了一则出售旧搁架的「分类广告」，附近有位学生给了回复。

words.enDefinition: an advertisement asking for a specific item someone wants

examples.en: I posted a wanted ad for a used copy of our chemistry textbook.
examples.zh: 我发了一则「求购广告」，想找我们化学教材的二手书。

examples.en: Two neighbours replied to my wanted ad for a small sewing machine.
examples.zh: 有两位邻居回复了我想买小型缝纫机的「求购广告」。

words.enDefinition: to sell something that you have bought or received

examples.en: I plan to resell my desk after the end of term.
examples.zh: 我打算学期结束后「转售」自己的书桌。

examples.en: The group collects old bicycles to repair and resell through its workshop.
examples.zh: 这个小组收集旧自行车，在工坊修好后再「转售」。

words.enDefinition: the amount credited for an item exchanged towards a purchase

examples.en: The store checked the screen before confirming my tablet's trade-in value that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，店家检查屏幕后才确定我那台平板的「以旧换新折抵金额」。

examples.en: The quoted trade-in value of the bike was written on the shop receipt.
examples.zh: 店家把给那辆自行车估的「以旧换新折抵金额」写在了收据上。

words.enDefinition: the amount a used item could sell for

examples.en: The tutor said the lens had a reasonable resale value even after years of use.
examples.zh: 老师说，那支镜头用了多年，还有不错的「转售价值」。

examples.en: When our couch faded in the sun, its resale value dropped considerably.
examples.zh: 沙发被阳光晒褪色后，「转售价值」大幅下降。

words.enDefinition: to purchase something that you sold to someone earlier

examples.en: The campus shop offered to buy back textbooks it sold earlier that term.
examples.zh: 校园商店表示愿意「回购」本学期早些时候售出的课本。

examples.en: Will the bike shop buy back the bicycle I bought there last spring?
examples.zh: 自行车店会「回购」我去年春天从那里买的那辆车吗？

collocations: agree to buy back a bike

words.enDefinition: a program that pays students for their used textbooks

examples.en: The campus textbook buyback had a table near the entrance to the library.
examples.zh: 校园「教材回购」活动在图书馆入口旁设了一张桌子。

examples.en: A friend took last semester's novels to the textbook buyback after the final.
examples.zh: 期末考试结束后，一位朋友把上学期的小说拿去了「教材回购」活动。

words.enDefinition: an individual selling something independently of a business

examples.en: The phone was offered by a private seller who lived near our campus.
examples.zh: 那部手机是住在校园附近的一位「个人卖家」挂出来的。

examples.en: I asked the private seller when she had last used the sewing machine.
examples.zh: 我问这位「个人卖家」上次使用这台缝纫机是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: offered directly by the person who owns the item

examples.en: The sign on the bicycle read for sale by owner and showed a contact number.
examples.zh: 自行车上的牌子写着「物主直售」，还留了一个联系电话。

examples.en: I filtered by for sale by owner listings when I was looking for a used canoe.
examples.zh: 我找旧独木舟时，按「物主直售」筛选了商品。

collocations: listed as for sale by owner

words.enDefinition: offered without payment to someone who will use it

examples.en: Our neighbour's spare table was free to a good home when she cleared out her garage.
examples.zh: 邻居清理车库时，愿把多出来的桌子「免费送给有需要的人」。

examples.en: The listing offered the plant pots free to a good home before the end of term.
examples.zh: 帖子说，学期结束前会把这些花盆「免费送给有需要的人」。

collocations: advertise as free to a good home
free to a good home listing
offer furniture free to a good home

words.enDefinition: in a condition that closely resembles a new item

examples.en: The seller listed the desk lamp as like new after barely using it.
examples.zh: 卖家几乎没用过这盏台灯，标注为「成色如新」。

examples.en: The textbook looks like new apart from the name written inside the cover.
examples.zh: 除了封面内侧写了名字，这本课本看起来「成色如新」。

words.enDefinition: a resale grade for used goods with limited wear

examples.en: The listing said the coat was in good used condition despite one missing button.
examples.zh: 商品页上写着，这件外套虽然少了一颗纽扣，但「二手成色良好」。

examples.en: I donated a bicycle in good used condition that my sister had outgrown.
examples.zh: 我捐出了一辆妹妹已经骑不了的自行车，车的「二手成色良好」。

words.enDefinition: a condition grade showing noticeable wear that limits appearance or quality

examples.en: My roommate expected the table in fair condition to have a few scratches.
examples.zh: 室友想，这张「成色一般」的桌子应该会有几道划痕。

examples.en: The chair was listed in fair condition because its seat was badly worn.
examples.zh: 椅子座面磨损明显，所以卖家标注为「成色一般」。

collocations: described as being in fair condition

words.enDefinition: used a lot and often showing wear as a result

examples.en: The listing described the chair as well loved and showed its worn corners.
examples.zh: 帖子称这把椅子「用过不少」，还展示了磨损的边角。

examples.en: The doll was well loved, with faded clothes and one missing shoe.
examples.zh: 这个娃娃「玩过很多次」了，衣服褪了色，还少了一只鞋。

words.enDefinition: showing only small marks from being used or worn

examples.en: The seller described the trainers as lightly worn and photographed both soles.
examples.zh: 卖家说运动鞋「有轻微磨损」，并拍了两只鞋的鞋底。

examples.en: I found a lightly worn denim jacket that was just my size.
examples.zh: 我找到一件「有轻微磨损」的牛仔夹克，正好合身。

words.enDefinition: able to perform all the functions it was designed for

examples.en: The keyboard is fully functional, but there are scratches around the space bar.
examples.zh: 键盘「功能完好」，不过空格键周围有划痕。

examples.en: I asked if the used camera was still fully functional before arranging collection.
examples.zh: 我在约取相机之前，问了这台二手相机是否仍「功能完好」。

words.enDefinition: working correctly and fit for its usual purpose

examples.en: We couldn't tell whether the record player was in working order from the photo.
examples.zh: 单看照片，我们无法判断唱机是否「可以正常使用」。

examples.en: I asked whether the sewing machine was in working order after the recent repair.
examples.zh: 我问那台缝纫机最近修过之后是否「可以正常使用」。

words.enDefinition: checked by trying it and found to operate properly

examples.en: The seller marked the used console as tested and working after playing a game.
examples.zh: 卖家用这台旧游戏机玩了一局后，标注为「经测试可正常使用」。

examples.en: The label on the donated radio said tested and working and gave a date.
examples.zh: 捐赠来的收音机标签写着「经测试可正常使用」，还标了日期。

words.enDefinition: offered without a check that it works as expected

examples.en: The old tape player was marked untested because it came without batteries.
examples.zh: 旧磁带机没带电池，所以标注为「未经测试」。

examples.en: The listing said the projector was untested, so I asked about the power cable.
examples.zh: 商品页写着投影仪「未经测试」，所以我问了电源线的情况。

words.enDefinition: offered mainly for its parts or for someone to fix

examples.en: My flatmate listed the broken bicycle for spares or repair in the student group.
examples.zh: 室友在学生群里把坏自行车挂出来，写着「供拆件或维修」。

examples.en: The seller said the old amplifier was for spares or repair because it produced no sound.
examples.zh: 卖家说旧功放没有声音，标注为「供拆件或维修」。

words.enDefinition: offered as a source of usable components rather than a complete item

examples.en: The camera with the broken body was listed for parts only online.
examples.zh: 那台机身损坏的相机在网上标为「仅供拆件」。

examples.en: The sign marked the old deck parts only after the motor failed.
examples.zh: 电机坏了以后，这个老式卡座被标为「仅供拆件」。

words.enDefinition: in the current condition of the item being sold

examples.en: The speaker was sold as is with a note about its loose knob.
examples.zh: 音箱「按现状出售」，备注里写明有个旋钮松了。

examples.en: The shop sells most donated lamps as is and describes any visible damage.
examples.zh: 店家把大部分捐来的灯具「按现状出售」，并说明可见的损伤。

collocations: buy a used item as is

words.enDefinition: damage to how something looks without necessarily affecting operation

examples.en: The seller photographed the cosmetic damage around one corner of the laptop.
examples.zh: 卖家拍下了笔记本电脑一角周围的「外观损伤」。

examples.en: The camera works, but the listing mentions cosmetic damage near the battery cover.
examples.zh: 相机能用，但商品页提到电池盖附近有「外观损伤」。

words.enDefinition: a slight hollow made by a hit or pressure

examples.en: The listing mentioned a small dent in the door of the mini fridge.
examples.zh: 商品页提到小冰箱门上有一处「小凹痕」。

examples.en: I noticed a small dent near the handle when I picked up the case.
examples.zh: 我拎起箱子时，看到提手附近有一处「小凹痕」。

words.enDefinition: paint with small pieces broken away from the surface

examples.en: The cabinet had chipped paint along the top but all its drawers worked.
examples.zh: 柜子顶部有几处「漆面剥落」，不过所有抽屉都能用。

examples.en: She pointed out the chipped paint on the frame before I paid.
examples.zh: 付款前，她指给我看架子上「漆面剥落」的地方。

words.enDefinition: edges of fabric or material that have started to unravel

examples.en: The rug had frayed edges, so I asked for a photo in daylight.
examples.zh: 地毯的「边缘磨散了」，所以我请卖家在日光下再拍一张照片。

examples.en: Even with its frayed edges, the denim bag looked sturdy enough for my books.
examples.zh: 虽然牛仔包的「边缘磨散了」，它看起来还是够结实，能装下我的书。

words.enDefinition: thread that has started to come away along a seam

examples.en: The coat's description mentioned loose stitching just below the left pocket.
examples.zh: 外套的描述写着，左侧口袋下方有「松脱的缝线」。

examples.en: I found some loose stitching near the zip when I inspected the backpack.
examples.zh: 我检查背包时，在拉链附近看到了「松脱的缝线」。

words.enDefinition: the formation of small balls of fibre on fabric

examples.en: She included a close-up of the fabric pilling near the sweater cuff.
examples.zh: 她附了一张毛衣袖口附近「面料起球」的特写照片。

examples.en: There was some fabric pilling on the coat where the bag strap rubbed.
examples.zh: 外套被包带磨到的地方有些「起球」。

words.enDefinition: a loss of colour caused by exposure to sunlight

examples.en: I noticed sun fading along the back of the sofa by the window.
examples.zh: 我发现靠窗的沙发背上有一片「日晒褪色」的痕迹。

examples.en: The curtain listing mentioned sun fading where the fabric faced the street.
examples.zh: 窗帘的商品页注明，面向街道的一侧有「日晒褪色」。

words.enDefinition: screws or other fittings needed for assembly that are absent

examples.en: The listing mentioned missing hardware, including the screws that attach the legs.
examples.zh: 商品页注明「缺少安装五金」，包括用来固定桌腿的螺丝。

examples.en: I asked the seller to list any missing hardware before reserving the shelf.
examples.zh: 我在预留搁架前，请卖家列出「缺少的安装五金」。

words.enDefinition: a set of items that go together in design or intended use

examples.en: The seller offered a matched set of shelves from the same student flat.
examples.zh: 卖家出售一套「配套的置物架」，都是同一间学生公寓里用过的。

examples.en: I bought the plates as a matched set from the campus swap meet.
examples.zh: 我在校园交换集市买了一组「配套的盘子」。

words.enDefinition: given a new surface finish to improve appearance

examples.en: Our neighbour sold us a refinished table with a darker wood finish.
examples.zh: 邻居卖给我们一张「表面已翻新」的桌子，木色比原来深。

examples.en: The refinished dresser still had its original yellow handles and wooden feet.
examples.zh: 这只「表面已翻新」的斗柜还保留着原来的黄色把手和木脚。

words.enDefinition: made from an older item given a new useful purpose

examples.en: We saw an upcycled lamp made from an old glass bottle.
examples.zh: 我们看到一盏用旧玻璃瓶「升级再造」的灯。

examples.en: An art student sold upcycled tote bags made from discarded curtains.
examples.zh: 一位艺术专业学生卖用废旧窗帘「升级再造」的托特包。

words.enDefinition: covered again with new fabric or leather on padded furniture

examples.en: We bought a reupholstered armchair after seeing the new green fabric in person.
examples.zh: 我们现场看了新换的绿色布料，买下了这把「重新包过面」的扶手椅。

examples.en: The seller showed me an older photo of the reupholstered dining chairs.
examples.zh: 卖家给我看了这些「重新包过面」的餐椅以前的照片。

words.enDefinition: a household where people do not smoke indoors

examples.en: The listing said the curtains came from a smoke-free home near campus.
examples.zh: 帖子上说，这些窗帘来自校园附近的一个「无烟家庭」。

examples.en: The seller said the books had always been kept in a smoke-free home.
examples.zh: 卖家说，这些书一直放在一个「无烟家庭」里。

words.enDefinition: a household where no pets are kept

examples.en: My roommate wanted to know whether the rug came from a pet-free home.
examples.zh: 室友想知道地毯是否来自「无宠物家庭」。

examples.en: The seller described the couch as coming from a pet-free home in the description.
examples.zh: 卖家在商品介绍里写明，这张沙发来自「无宠物家庭」。

words.enDefinition: to publish an advertisement offering something to buyers

examples.en: I have two extra chairs to list for sale in our student group.
examples.zh: 我有两把多余的椅子，想在学生群里「挂出出售」。

examples.en: Which books from last semester do you still have to list for sale?
examples.zh: 你上学期还有哪些课本要「挂出出售」？

words.enDefinition: to show in a listing that someone has bought the item

examples.en: I marked my desk as sold but forgot to mark as sold the chair.
examples.zh: 我把书桌标为已售了，却忘了把椅子也「标为已售」。

examples.en: The group asks sellers to mark as sold any listings for items already collected.
examples.zh: 群里请卖家把商品已被取走的帖子「标为已售」。

collocations: mark as sold in the app

words.enDefinition: reserved or sold but still waiting to be collected

examples.en: The desk was marked pending pickup by the time I checked the listing.
examples.zh: 我查看商品页时，那张桌子已经标为「待买家取货」。

examples.en: The notice showed pending pickup, so I asked to be next in line.
examples.zh: 告示显示「待买家取货」，于是我留言说想排下一位。

words.enDefinition: to post an item for sale again

examples.en: The first buyer changed her mind, so I decided to relist an item.
examples.zh: 第一个买家改了主意，所以我决定「重新刊登商品」。

examples.en: The marketplace lets sellers relist an item when their original listing has expired.
examples.zh: 原来的帖子过期后，平台允许卖家「重新刊登商品」。

collocations: relist an item after a cancellation
relist an item at a lower price
relist an item with new photos

words.enDefinition: to move an older sale post higher in a marketplace feed

examples.en: The app offered to bump a listing so more local buyers might see it.
examples.zh: 应用提供了「把帖子顶上去」的功能，让更多本地买家有机会看到。

examples.en: Our student resale group has a rule about when you can bump a listing.
examples.zh: 我们的学生二手群对什么时候能「把帖子顶上去」有规定。

collocations: bump a listing in a group

words.enDefinition: to remove a post offering something for sale

examples.en: I'll take down a listing once the buyer has collected the last dining chair.
examples.zh: 买家把最后一把餐椅取走后，我就会「撤下商品帖子」。

examples.en: I asked the moderator how to take down a listing after noticing a duplicate.
examples.zh: 发现同一商品发了两遍后，我问管理员怎么「撤下商品帖子」。

collocations: take down a listing after a sale
ask someone to take down a listing
take down a listing from a marketplace

words.enDefinition: to purchase several things together under one price

examples.en: Can I buy as a bundle if I want the camera, bag, and extra lens?
examples.zh: 相机、包和额外的镜头我都想要，可以「打包购买」吗？

examples.en: The pans were cheaper to buy as a bundle than they were to buy individually.
examples.zh: 这些锅「打包购买」比单买更便宜。

collocations: available to buy as a bundle
cheaper to buy as a bundle

words.enDefinition: a group of goods sold together in one transaction

examples.en: My flatmate bought a job lot of kitchen utensils at a local auction.
examples.zh: 室友在本地拍卖会上买了「成批出售」的一组厨具。

examples.en: The poster offered the old records as a job lot rather than individually.
examples.zh: 帖子说那些旧唱片是「成批出售」的。

words.enDefinition: payment in cash when the buyer collects the item

examples.en: The advert said cash on collection for the small bookshelf near the station.
examples.zh: 广告说，车站附近的那个小书架要「取货时付现金」。

examples.en: I asked if the seller accepted cash on collection for the spare desk lamp.
examples.zh: 我问那个多出来的台灯能不能「取货时付现金」。

words.enDefinition: to exchange one thing for a different item

examples.en: I brought old novels to the fair to swap for books from my list.
examples.zh: 我把旧小说带到集市上，想「换取」清单里的书。

examples.en: I've got two used textbooks I could swap for a spare lamp.
examples.zh: 我有两本旧课本，可以「换取」一盏闲置台灯。

collocations: what to swap for a bike

words.enDefinition: the amount a seller initially wants for an item

examples.en: I offered less than the asking price because the speaker was missing a cable.
examples.zh: 因为音箱少了根线，我出的价低于「卖方要价」。

examples.en: The asking price on the old bike included a lock and a helmet.
examples.zh: 旧自行车的「卖方要价」包含一把锁和一个头盔。

words.enDefinition: the seller is unwilling to accept a lower price

examples.en: The seller said the price is firm because she included the folding stand.
examples.zh: 卖家说「价格不议」，因为已经把折叠支架算在里面了。

examples.en: The message under the photo said the price is firm for both chairs together.
examples.zh: 照片下方的消息写着，两把椅子合卖的「价格不议」。

collocations: the price is firm at that amount
ask whether the price is firm

words.enDefinition: indicating that a seller is willing to consider proposed prices

examples.en: I noticed offers considered underneath the asking price for the old guitar.
examples.zh: 我在旧吉他的标价下面看到了「愿意考虑买家出价」。

examples.en: The advert said offers considered, so my roommate sent the seller a message.
examples.zh: 广告写着「愿意考虑买家出价」，于是室友给卖家发了消息。

collocations: offers considered on the whole set

words.enDefinition: indicating that the seller may accept the best alternative price offered

examples.en: The notice said eighty dollars or best offer for the old kitchen table.
examples.zh: 告示说，旧餐桌要价八十美元，「或接受最合适出价」。

examples.en: I asked what or best offer meant in the listing for the used bike.
examples.zh: 我问那辆旧自行车商品页上的「或接受最合适出价」是什么意思。

collocations: price shown as or best offer

words.enDefinition: a proposed price far below what the seller expects

examples.en: The seller ignored the lowball offer and answered my question about the case.
examples.zh: 卖家没理会那个「过低的出价」，回复了我关于盒子的问题。

examples.en: I thought it was a lowball offer for a bike in such good condition.
examples.zh: 这辆自行车成色这么好，我觉得那是个「过低的出价」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing a price proposal is no longer active

examples.en: The screen showed offer expired when I opened the message after my lecture.
examples.zh: 上完课打开消息时，屏幕显示「出价已过期」。

examples.en: I saw offer expired beside my offer on the small dining table.
examples.zh: 我在小餐桌的出价旁看到了「出价已过期」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that someone turned down a proposed price

examples.en: The notification read offer declined after I suggested a price for the bike.
examples.zh: 我给自行车提出购买价后，通知显示「出价被拒」。

examples.en: I saw offer declined on the listing before I could arrange a viewing.
examples.zh: 我还没来得及约看，就在商品页上看到了「出价被拒」。

collocations: notification that an offer was declined

words.enDefinition: a status showing someone agreed to the proposed price

examples.en: The app showed offer accepted before the seller contacted me about pickup.
examples.zh: 卖家联系我约取货之前，应用已经显示「出价已接受」。

examples.en: I received an offer accepted notification just before our morning language class.
examples.zh: 上午的语言课快开始时，我收到一条「出价已接受」的通知。

words.enDefinition: to keep an item available for a particular buyer temporarily

examples.en: The seller agreed to hold an item until a student could view it Saturday.
examples.zh: 卖家同意「暂时留货」，等一位同学周六来看。

examples.en: At the swap meet, one stall was happy to hold an item until noon.
examples.zh: 在交换集市上，有个摊位愿意「暂时留货」到中午。

collocations: ask someone to hold an item

words.enDefinition: to look at an item directly in the same place

examples.en: I'd like to see it in person because the fabric looks different in each photo.
examples.zh: 我想「当面看实物」，因为每张照片里的布料看起来都不一样。

examples.en: Can I see it in person before you take the listing down this evening?
examples.zh: 你今天傍晚撤掉帖子前，我能「当面看一下实物」吗？

collocations: ask to see it in person
want to see it in person
see it in person before paying

words.expression: take it for a test ride
words.lemma: take it for a test ride
words.enDefinition: to ride a vehicle briefly to check how it feels
acceptedEnVariants: take it for a test ride

examples.en: Can I take it for a test ride to see whether the frame fits me properly?
examples.zh: 我能「骑上去试一圈」，看看车架的尺寸合不合适吗？

examples.en: She liked the saddle and asked if she could take it for a test ride after class.
examples.zh: 她喜欢这个车座，就问能不能下课后「骑上去试一圈」。

collocations: ask to take it for a test ride
let someone take it for a test ride
take it for a test ride around the block

words.enDefinition: to test an item before deciding whether to purchase it

examples.en: The instrument shop lets students try before you buy if they make an appointment.
examples.zh: 乐器店允许学生预约后「先试再买」。

examples.en: The notice invited buyers to try before you buy at the campus bike sale.
examples.zh: 告示邀请买家在校园自行车售卖会上「先试再买」。

collocations: option to try before you buy
encourage buyers to try before you buy
room to try before you buy

words.enDefinition: to connect something to an outlet so it receives electricity

examples.en: Can we plug it in at the counter to see whether the lamp works?
examples.zh: 我们能在柜台这儿「插上电源」，看看台灯亮不亮吗？

examples.en: The vendor offered to plug it in before I made up my mind.
examples.zh: 摊主说，可以「插上电源」给我看看，我再决定。

collocations: plug it in at the counter

words.enDefinition: asks whether a device can power on at all

examples.en: The first question I had was, "Does it turn on with the original charger?"
examples.zh: 我第一个问题是，用原装充电器「能开机吗」？

examples.en: I messaged the seller, "Does it turn on when you press the power button?"
examples.zh: 我给卖家发消息问，按下电源键「能开机吗」？

collocations: does it turn on at all
does it turn on with the charger

words.enDefinition: photographs that show the present appearance of an item

examples.en: Could you send me some current photos of the suitcase before I visit?
examples.zh: 我上门看箱子前，你能给我发几张箱子的「近期实拍照」吗？

examples.en: The seller added current photos after I asked about the torn seat fabric.
examples.zh: 我问起座椅面料撕裂的情况后，卖家补发了几张「近期实拍照」。

words.enDefinition: indicating that the images show the exact item being sold

examples.en: The listing said actual item pictured beside the photo of the brass lamp.
examples.zh: 商品页在黄铜台灯的照片旁标了「照片为商品实拍」。

examples.en: I checked for actual item pictured because I wanted to see the camera's condition.
examples.zh: 我想看相机的实际成色，所以找了找有没有「照片为商品实拍」的标注。

words.enDefinition: a photograph showing the information printed on a physical label

examples.en: Could you send a photo of the label so I can see the coat size?
examples.zh: 你能发张「标签照片」，让我看看这件外套的尺码吗？

examples.en: The seller posted a photo of the label next to the pictures of the chair.
examples.zh: 卖家在椅子的照片旁放了一张「标签照片」。

collocations: request a photo of the label
send a photo of the label
include a photo of the label

words.enDefinition: to verify the measurements of a physical item

examples.en: Can you check the dimensions before I borrow a car to collect the desk?
examples.zh: 我借车来搬书桌前，你能「核对一下尺寸」吗？

examples.en: We need to check the dimensions to see whether the cabinet fits our hallway.
examples.zh: 我们得「核对尺寸」，看看橱柜能不能放进走廊。

collocations: check the dimensions of the shelf
ask someone to check the dimensions

words.enDefinition: a code used to confirm that an item was collected

examples.en: The marketplace app displayed a pickup code after I paid for the lamp.
examples.zh: 我付了台灯的钱后，二手交易应用显示了一个「取货核验码」。

examples.en: The seller scanned my pickup code when I took the desk away.
examples.zh: 我搬走书桌时，卖家扫描了我的「取货核验码」。

words.enDefinition: indicating the seller will not send an item by post or courier

examples.en: The listing said no shipping because the mirror was too bulky to pack.
examples.zh: 镜子太大，不好打包，所以商品页写着「不提供邮寄」。

examples.en: I was already nearby when I saw no shipping on the seller's post.
examples.zh: 我看到卖家帖子写着「不提供邮寄」时，人已经在附近了。

words.enDefinition: to see one another physically in the same place

examples.en: We decided to meet in person once we both finished our afternoon classes.
examples.zh: 我们决定等两个人都上完下午的课，再「当面碰面」交接东西。

examples.en: Would you rather meet in person to exchange the books on Friday afternoon?
examples.zh: 你想周五下午「当面碰面」交换那几本书吗？

collocations: meet in person to exchange items

words.enDefinition: to meet somewhere roughly between two people's starting places

examples.en: Would you be willing to meet halfway so neither of us needs the bus?
examples.zh: 你愿意「各走一半路碰面」吗？这样我们谁都不用坐公交。

examples.en: The seller offered to meet halfway because we lived on opposite sides of campus.
examples.zh: 我们住在校园两头，所以卖家提议「各走一半路碰面」。

words.enDefinition: collection of an item left on a seller's porch

examples.en: The listing offered porch pickup for a box of free plant pots.
examples.zh: 帖子说，可以到「门廊自取」一箱免费的花盆。

examples.en: The neighbour asked if porch pickup would suit me before the weekend.
examples.zh: 邻居问我周末前「门廊自取」方不方便。

words.enDefinition: to come with another person who can help lift something

examples.en: Should I bring someone to help lift the dresser when I come to pick it up?
examples.zh: 我来取斗柜时，要不要「带个人帮忙抬」？

examples.en: The listing said to bring someone to help lift the piano into the buyer's van.
examples.zh: 商品页提醒要「带个人帮忙抬」，把钢琴搬进买家的厢式车。

collocations: need to bring someone to help lift
tell buyers to bring someone to help lift
ask whether to bring someone to help lift

words.enDefinition: small enough to carry inside a particular car

examples.en: I measured the shelf to make sure it fits in the car with both seats down.
examples.zh: 我量了搁架的尺寸，确认放倒两个座位后它「装得进汽车」。

examples.en: The table fits in the car once the seller takes the legs off today.
examples.zh: 卖家今天把桌腿卸下来后，桌子就「装得进汽车」。

collocations: check whether it fits in the car
make sure it fits in the car
see if it fits in the car

words.enDefinition: indicating an item has been picked up by someone

examples.en: The free cupboard showed as already collected when I checked the group.
examples.zh: 我查看群消息时，那个免费橱柜已标为「已被取走」。

examples.en: The seller said the chair was already collected before the listing came down.
examples.zh: 卖家说，帖子撤下前，椅子就「已被取走」了。

words.enDefinition: a buyer who fails to arrive for an arranged meeting

examples.en: The seller put the plant stand back up after a no-show buyer.
examples.zh: 有位「买家爽约」后，卖家重新挂出了花架。

examples.en: I bought the bike after a no-show buyer missed the morning pickup.
examples.zh: 原本约好上午来取货的「买家爽约」了，后来我买下了那辆自行车。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that a pickup has been organized

examples.en: The order showed collection arranged after we agreed to meet on Thursday.
examples.zh: 我们约好周四碰面后，订单的状态变成了「取货时间已约好」。

examples.en: I saw collection arranged next to the order when I opened the message.
examples.zh: 我打开消息时，在订单旁看见了「取货时间已约好」。

words.enDefinition: to indicate that the item has been received

examples.en: The app asked me to confirm receipt after the seller handed over the lamp.
examples.zh: 卖家把台灯交给我后，应用请我「确认收到商品」。

examples.en: I forgot to confirm receipt and received a reminder before my next class.
examples.zh: 我忘了「确认收到商品」，下节课前收到了一条提醒。

collocations: ask the buyer to confirm receipt

words.enDefinition: a course book someone owned before it was put up for sale

examples.en: I bought a used textbook from a student who finished the course last term.
examples.zh: 我从上学期修完这门课的同学手里买了本「二手教材」。

examples.en: The shop had one used textbook with the right cover and edition number.
examples.zh: 店里有一本「二手教材」，封面和版次都对。

words.enDefinition: an edition of a textbook published for distribution in international markets

examples.en: The seller had the international edition of our economics textbook at the flea market.
examples.zh: 卖家在跳蚤市场上卖我们经济学教材的「国际版」。

examples.en: I asked my tutor whether the international edition had the same chapter numbers.
examples.zh: 我问老师，「国际版教材」的章节编号是否相同。

words.enDefinition: indicating that a code for online course materials has been redeemed

examples.en: The seller wrote access code already used beside the photo of the textbook's back cover.
examples.zh: 卖家在教材封底的照片旁注明「访问码已使用」。

examples.en: The bookshop label read access code already used beneath the price of the used workbook.
examples.zh: 旧练习册价格下方的店铺标签注明「访问码已使用」。

collocations: listed with access code already used
notice reading access code already used
label marked access code already used

words.enDefinition: colour added over text to mark important parts

examples.en: The listing said there was highlighting in the first three chapters only.
examples.zh: 商品页注明，只有前三章有「高亮标记」。

examples.en: I didn't mind the highlighting because all the figures were still readable.
examples.zh: 我不介意「高亮标记」，因为所有图表都看得清。

words.enDefinition: words written in ink on the inside of a book

examples.en: The postcard album had an ink inscription on the inside of the cover.
examples.zh: 明信片册的封面内侧有一处「墨水题字」。

examples.en: The seller showed a photo of the ink inscription on the first page.
examples.zh: 卖家发来一张照片，能看到第一页上的「墨水题字」。

words.enDefinition: a book spine or fastening that no longer holds pages tightly

examples.en: The seller mentioned a loose binding and sent photos of the book's spine.
examples.zh: 卖家说这本书「装订松动」，并发来了书脊的照片。

examples.en: I could feel the loose binding when I opened the old cookbook fully.
examples.zh: 我把那本旧菜谱完全摊开时，感觉到它「装订松动」。

words.enDefinition: pages that are absent from a book or printed document

examples.en: I checked for missing pages while looking through the atlas at the stall.
examples.zh: 我在摊位翻看地图册时，检查了有没有「缺页」。

examples.en: The seller mentioned missing pages at the end of the used workbook online.
examples.zh: 卖家在网上注明，那本旧练习册的末尾有「缺页」。

words.enDefinition: a removable paper cover placed around a hardback book

examples.en: The hardback didn't have a dust jacket, but its cover was in good condition.
examples.zh: 这本精装书没有「外护封」，不过封面保存得不错。

examples.en: I asked for a photo of the dust jacket before ordering the novel.
examples.zh: 我下单买这本小说前，向卖家要了张「图书外护封」的照片。

words.enDefinition: a container where people leave items for an organization to collect

examples.en: I checked what the donation bin could accept before bringing my old clothes.
examples.zh: 我先看了「捐赠箱」能收什么，再把旧衣服带过去。

examples.en: The student volunteers moved the donation bin inside when it started raining.
examples.zh: 下雨后，学生志愿者把「捐赠箱」搬进了屋里。

collocations: put clothes in a donation bin
donated items in a donation bin

words.enDefinition: a shop where people can take donated items without paying

examples.en: I found three mugs at the campus free store before moving into residence.
examples.zh: 住进宿舍前，我在学校的「免费取物店」找到了三个马克杯。

examples.en: The free store takes kitchenware and winter clothing donated by students leaving campus.
examples.zh: 「免费取物店」接收离校学生捐出的厨具和冬衣。

words.enDefinition: a local Buy Nothing community that gives things away freely

examples.en: Someone in our Buy Nothing group offered an extra chair for my flat.
examples.zh: 我们「社区免费互赠群」里有人要送一把多余的椅子，正好我公寓用得上。

examples.en: My neighbour found a spare watering can through the Buy Nothing group last week.
examples.zh: 邻居上周通过「社区免费互赠群」找到一个闲置浇水壶。

collocations: post in a Buy Nothing group

words.enDefinition: someone who runs a stall at a market

examples.en: I asked the stallholder if I could see the other plates.
examples.zh: 我问「摊主」能不能让我看看其他盘子。

examples.en: The stallholder put a sold sign on the wooden chair after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，「摊主」在木椅上放了块已售的牌子。

words.enDefinition: to sell goods for their owners and take a share

examples.en: The vintage shop offered to sell on consignment for students leaving in June.
examples.zh: 复古店表示，可以给六月离校的学生提供「寄卖」服务。

examples.en: The charity fair did not accept books to sell on consignment that year.
examples.zh: 那一年，慈善集市不接收用于「寄卖」的书。

collocations: sell on consignment through a shop

words.enDefinition: the share of a sale kept by the person selling it

examples.en: The consignment shop explained its seller's commission before I left the coat.
examples.zh: 我把外套留在寄卖店前，店家说明了他们收取的「寄卖佣金」。

examples.en: The chair sold quickly, and the seller's commission was listed on the receipt.
examples.zh: 椅子很快卖出，收据上列了「寄卖佣金」。

words.enDefinition: leather made from an animal hide rather than manufactured material

examples.en: The bag was labelled genuine leather inside the small zipped pocket.
examples.zh: 包的小拉链袋里标有「真皮」字样。

examples.en: The seller described the sofa as genuine leather and showed me the label.
examples.zh: 卖家说这张沙发是「真皮」的，还给我看了标签。

collocations: check for a genuine leather label

words.enDefinition: parts supplied by the company that originally made the item

examples.en: The bike still had its original parts except for the seat and tyres.
examples.zh: 除了车座和轮胎，那辆自行车还保留着「原厂零件」。

examples.en: I asked whether the old coffee grinder still had its original parts.
examples.zh: 我问那台旧咖啡研磨机是否还装着「原厂零件」。

words.enDefinition: the person who owned an item before its current owner

examples.en: The previous owner had put a small name label under the seat.
examples.zh: 「前任物主」在座位底下贴了一张小姓名标签。

examples.en: The shop said the previous owner had kept the camera in its case.
examples.zh: 店家说，「前任物主」一直把相机放在相机盒里。

words.enDefinition: an item has had only one owner since it was new

examples.en: The advert said one owner from new and showed the bike's original shop receipt.
examples.zh: 广告写着那辆车「只有一任物主」，并展示了店铺原始收据。

examples.en: I saw one owner from new in the advert for the used guitar amplifier.
examples.zh: 我在二手吉他音箱的广告上看到了「只有一任物主」。

collocations: listed as one owner from new
described as one owner from new
bike with one owner from new

words.enDefinition: without the charger normally expected to come with a device

examples.en: The tablet was missing the charger, so the seller let me test it first.
examples.zh: 那台平板「没有附充电器」，于是卖家先让我试用。

examples.en: I told my flatmate the camera was missing the charger before we collected it.
examples.zh: 去取相机前，我告诉室友，那台相机「没有附充电器」。

collocations: check if it's missing the charger

words.enDefinition: a battery put in place of one that no longer works

examples.en: The seller had fitted a replacement battery to the watch before listing it.
examples.zh: 卖家在挂出手表前，已经装上了「替换电池」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the used camera needed a replacement battery soon.
examples.zh: 室友问这台二手相机是不是很快就需要「替换电池」。

words.enDefinition: a measure of how well a battery still holds charge

examples.en: I asked about battery health because the phone was several years old.
examples.zh: 我问了「电池健康度」，因为那部手机已经用了好几年。

examples.en: The used laptop listing included a screenshot showing its battery health.
examples.zh: 那台二手笔记本电脑的商品页附了一张显示「电池健康度」的截图。

words.enDefinition: a slip or message showing that a buyer has collected an item

examples.en: The seller sent a collection receipt after I took the used desk home.
examples.zh: 我把二手书桌搬回家后，卖家发来了「取货凭条」。

examples.en: I saved the collection receipt in the same folder as the listing photos.
examples.zh: 我把「取货凭条」和商品页的照片保存在同一个文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: the amount to pay for one of several items

examples.en: I checked the price per item because the stall had six matching cups.
examples.zh: 摊位上有六个一样的杯子，我确认了「每件单价」。

examples.en: The seller wrote the price per item on a tag beside the bowls.
examples.zh: 卖家在碗旁边的价签上写了「每件单价」。

collocations: ask for the price per item

words.enDefinition: an advertisement that sets a price rather than inviting bids

examples.en: I chose a fixed-price listing because I needed the chair by Friday.
examples.zh: 因为周五之前就需要椅子，我选了一个「固定价格商品帖」。

examples.en: The marketplace displayed a fixed-price listing next to the auction for a similar bike.
examples.zh: 平台在一辆类似自行车的拍卖信息旁展示了一个「固定价格商品帖」。

words.enDefinition: a sale on the internet where buyers compete by bidding

examples.en: I won the online auction for an old film camera last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚，我在「在线拍卖」中拍到了一台旧胶片相机。

examples.en: The student society held an online auction for donated instruments in June.
examples.zh: 学生社团六月为捐赠来的乐器举办了一次「在线拍卖」。

words.enDefinition: to state the amount you will pay in an auction

examples.en: I wanted to place a bid on the bike before the auction ended.
examples.zh: 我想在拍卖结束前给那辆自行车「出价竞拍」。

examples.en: My flatmate decided to place a bid after the seller measured the table.
examples.zh: 卖家量过桌子的尺寸后，室友决定「出价竞拍」。

collocations: place a bid on a lot

words.enDefinition: to offer more than another person in an auction

examples.en: I thought my classmate might outbid me for the used guitar.
examples.zh: 我以为同学竞拍那把旧吉他时可能「出价比我高」。

examples.en: The same bidder managed to outbid me on both camera lenses.
examples.zh: 同一个竞买人在两个相机镜头上的「出价都高于」我。

words.enDefinition: the final successful price offered by a bidder at auction

examples.en: The winning bid for the desk was less than I had expected.
examples.zh: 那张书桌的「最高成交出价」比我预想的低。

examples.en: My friend placed the winning bid for the bicycle at the student auction.
examples.zh: 朋友在学生拍卖会上给那辆自行车报出了「最高成交出价」。

words.enDefinition: a community event where volunteers help people mend broken belongings

examples.en: A volunteer at the repair café showed me my thrifted lamp worked again.
examples.zh: 「社区修理聚会」上的一位志愿者让我看了看，我淘来的灯又能亮了。

examples.en: The student union advertised a repair café beside the furniture swap on Saturday.
examples.zh: 学生会宣传了周六的「社区修理聚会」，地点就在家具交换活动旁边。

collocations: bring an item to a repair café

words.enDefinition: indicating that an additional key comes with the item

examples.en: The ad said spare key included in the details for the bike lock.
examples.zh: 那把自行车锁的广告详情写着「附有备用钥匙」。

examples.en: I noticed spare key included at the bottom of the post about the cabinet.
examples.zh: 我在橱柜帖子的底部看到了「附有备用钥匙」。

words.enDefinition: indicating that an item lacks the box it originally came in

examples.en: I bought the game without the original box at a stall near the station.
examples.zh: 我在车站附近的摊位买了这款游戏，「不带原包装盒」。

examples.en: The seller offered the camera without the original box but included a soft case.
examples.zh: 卖家的相机「不带原包装盒」，不过附带一个软包。

words.enDefinition: having been tried or used on a single occasion

examples.en: The tent was advertised as used once during a weekend trip last summer.
examples.zh: 广告说，这顶帐篷去年夏天周末出游时「只用过一次」。

examples.en: The seller marked the drill used once and included photos of the handle.
examples.zh: 卖家把电钻标为「只用过一次」，还附上了提手的照片。

words.enDefinition: the lowest amount at which bidding opens in an auction

examples.en: The starting bid for the bicycle was lower than I expected that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，那辆自行车的「起拍价」比我预想的低。

examples.en: I checked the starting bid before adding the camera auction to my list.
examples.zh: 我查看了「起拍价」，才把相机的拍卖加入关注列表。

words.enDefinition: the amount by which a bid must typically increase

examples.en: The auction page showed the bid increment just below the current price.
examples.zh: 拍卖页面在当前价格下方显示了「加价幅度」。

examples.en: I asked about the bid increment when the campus auction opened on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六校园拍卖开始时，我问了「加价幅度」。
